project.name: [SANDBOX] Dogfood Continuous Discovery - Importer Cleanup
project.brief: Start with an importer cleanup, then capture a discovered schema mismatch as a blocker issue and a non-blocking documentation candidate without losing the original project shape.
principles: The original plan is a starting model.
Non-blocking scope expansions remain candidates until coordinator review.

discoveryEvents.reason: Importer validation found a schema mismatch required for acceptance.
Runbook copy is useful but not required for importer correctness.

issues.title: Guide: Agent Operating Guide
issues.description:
## Objective
Preserve the original importer cleanup brief and Continuous Discovery rules.

## Context
This project intentionally includes discovered work.

## Acceptance Criteria
- Blocker discoveries become issues.
- Non-blocking documentation expansion remains a candidate.
- Ledger records why each discovery exists.

## Verification
Read back issue graph and Continuous Discovery log.

## Notes For Future Agents
DOG-C-004 was discovered by DOG-C-003 and blocks final verification.

issues.title: Guide: Verification Matrix
issues.description:
## Objective
Define importer cleanup verification and discovery closeout requirements.

## Context
Verification must include the discovered blocker once it exists.

## Acceptance Criteria
- Importer tests are named.
- Schema mismatch verification is included.
- Candidate documentation issue is not required for closeout.

## Verification
Review after discovery and before final closeout.

## Notes For Future Agents
Update this matrix when blocker or QA gap discoveries change acceptance.

issues.title: Clean importer validation path
issues.description:
## Objective
Clean the importer validation path.

## Context
During this work, a schema mismatch may be discovered.

## Scope
- Owned work: importer validation code.
- Non-scope: schema migration unless discovery proves it blocks acceptance.

## Acceptance Criteria
- Validation code is simpler and covered by tests.
- Blocking discoveries are created as new issues, not buried in notes.

## Verification
Run importer validation tests.

## Notes For Future Agents
This issue surfaced DOG-C-004 and DOG-C-006.

issues.title: Discovered blocker: reconcile importer schema mismatch
issues.description:
## Why It Was Discovered
Importer validation found that accepted payloads include a field not represented in the schema mapping.

## Surfaced By
DOG-C-003 Clean importer validation path.

## Classification
Blocker.

## Objective
Reconcile the schema mismatch required for importer cleanup acceptance.

## Dependencies / Blockers
- Blocked by: DOG-C-003 discovery evidence.
- Blocks: DOG-C-005 final verification.

## Acceptance Criteria
- Schema mapping accepts the confirmed field or rejects it deliberately with documented rationale.
- Importer tests cover the mismatch.

## Verification
Run importer schema and validation tests.

## Future-Agent Context
This issue was not in the original plan; it was created because acceptance would otherwise be false.

issues.title: Final importer verification and closeout
issues.description:
## Objective
Verify importer cleanup plus discovered blocker resolution.

## Context
DOG-C-006 is a non-blocking candidate and must not block closeout unless accepted by the coordinator.

## Acceptance Criteria
- Importer validation and schema tests pass.
- Continuous Discovery log names created and candidate issues.
- Completion comment explains residual risks and follow-ups.

## Verification
Run importer test suite and ledger read-back.

## Notes For Future Agents
Confirm DOG-C-006 remains proposed or explicitly accepted before adding scope.

issues.title: Candidate: document importer payload edge cases
issues.description:
## Why It Was Discovered
DOG-C-003 revealed importer payload edge cases that would benefit from runbook documentation.

## Surfaced By
DOG-C-003 Clean importer validation path.

## Classification
Documentation gap.

## Create / Propose / Log
Propose. This should not block DOG-C-005 unless accepted by the coordinator.

## Acceptance Criteria
- Runbook explains accepted payload edge cases.
- Examples match verified schema behavior.

## Verification
Docs review after coordinator acceptance.

## Future-Agent Context
This is useful but non-blocking scope expansion.
